items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: He was playing jazz violin, and when Stuff started acting up, you know, so the clubowners put us together.

ctx.x: And you worked with Ben then and who else?
Don Byas, Ben, and with the same Ray Perry I just spoke about. He was playing jazz violin, and when Stuff started acting up, you know, so the clubowners put us together.
So it was a trio, you and John and Ray Perry.
